scripts.build: npx tsc && npx vite build && node scripts/generate-sw-precache.mjs
scripts.build:strict: npm run lint:a11y && npm run build
scripts.verify: node scripts/check-no-secrets.mjs && npm run lint && npm run build:strict && npm run test:run && npm run validate-kong && npm run bundle:report
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && npx playwright test --config playwright.visual.config.ts
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run build && npx playwright test --config playwright.visual.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.build-android: npm run validate-android-env && npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build-ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android-debug-apk: npm run build-android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.test:rules: npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --project demo-n4-rules --only firestore "npx vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:integration: npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --project demo-q1-integration --only auth,firestore "npx vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts"
